evidence.title: Napkin AI - Turn Text into AI Diagrams and Visuals

name: Napkin AI
summary: Turns typed or pasted text into editable diagrams, mind maps, flowcharts, charts and slide decks.
description: Text-to-visual generator: paste or type text and Napkin proposes editable diagrams, mind maps, flowcharts, timelines and data charts, plus full slide decks in the Slides beta. Results export as PNG, PDF, SVG or PPT, and a REST API returns generated visuals in 60+ languages. Free tier with 500 weekly credits; Plus and Pro add credits, exports and branding.
contains: generators: visuals, slides (beta), timeline, chart, flowchart, mind map
free tier: 500 AI credits per week
Plus $9 and Pro $22 per person per month, 25% off with annual billing
developer API returns PNG, SVG or PPT in 60+ languages
free plan includes unlimited PNG and PDF export and file import
